title: Zesty Tender Italian Egg Frittata
description: A pungent and tender Italian dish featuring ginger paste, perfect for a low-carb breakfast, with a lacquer-glaze finish for added flavor and texture. This energizing frittata is made with wholesome ingredients and is easy to prepare.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Whisk the eggs in a large bowl and set aside.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the ginger paste and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the chopped spinach and cook until wilted, about 2 minutes.
Pour the whisked eggs over the spinach mixture and cook until the edges start to set.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 15 minutes.
Remove the skillet from the oven and brush the lacquer glaze over the top of the frittata.
Return the skillet to the oven and bake for an additional 2 minutes.
Remove the skillet from the oven and let the frittata cool for a few minutes before slicing and serving.
